## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user-visible problem, the new behavior and the canonical owner of the change. Link an existing issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Explain any checks not run. Include screenshots for visible UI changes when helpful; use synthetic content, never real planning documents or credentials.

## Deployment and recovery

Describe relevant migrations, configuration or permission changes and a recovery path. For a change without deployment impact, say so briefly. Update the corresponding API or deployment documentation alongside behavior changes.
